name: review-bench
description: Every decision your code makes, journey by journey, in plain words. Uses the Copilot you are signed in to.

reviewBench.model.description: The Copilot model Review Bench uses, by its family name (for example claude-sonnet-4 or gpt-4.1). Empty picks one for you. "Review Bench: Choose the model" lists what you have.

reviewBench.look.description: plain: the quiet look, with Review Bench only in the footer. full: the Review Bench look with logo and colour.
